description: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of sample counts across six distinct reasoning categories used in the SRPO framework for enhancing multimodal LLM reasoning via reflection-aware reinforcement learning. The vertical axis, labeled “Number of Samples,” is presented on a logarithmic scale ranging from 10² to 10⁴, with gridlines at each power of ten. The horizontal axis lists the reasoning categories in descending order of sample count: Mathematical Reasoning, General Reasoning, Natural Scene Reasoning, Physical Reasoning, Logical Puzzle Reasoning, and Chemical Reasoning. Each category is represented by a light blue vertical bar, with the exact sample count labeled above each bar. Mathematical Reasoning has the highest sample count at approximately 9,000 (just under 10⁴), followed by General Reasoning with 1,709 samples, Natural Scene Reasoning with 413, Physical Reasoning with 232, Logical Puzzle Reasoning with 91, and Chemical Reasoning with the fewest at 49. The bars are sorted in descending order from left to right, visually emphasizing the disparity in data distribution across reasoning types, with Mathematical Reasoning dominating the dataset. No additional visual emphasis (e.g., shading, outlines, or annotations) is applied beyond the numerical labels.
